feeds.title: BOC Blog
feeds.description: Read news and articles on athletic training and credentialing programs. The Board of Certification, Inc. has been responsible for the certification of Athletic Trainers since 1989. Athletic Trainers (ATs) are healthcare professionals who render service or treatment, under the direction of or in collaboration with a physician, in accordance with their education and training and the states' statutes, rules and regulations.

feeds.title: The Athlete Blog
feeds.description: The Athlete Blog is a place to get inspired to say yes to any adventure without wondering if you're fit or strong enough to do so. I'm Andrejs, I started The Athlete Blog as a place to inspire others to start their own adventures and live life to the fullest. Healthy, strong, uber-productive, and - ultimately - happy. Besides that, I also share my experience across multiple sports (both as an amateur and as a pro) to help others get in top shape and able to fulfill all those crazy and awesome dreams.
